# cash-ledger + fixed-price micro-automation (AEO-001 EX-001)

> Free MIT Python CLI: append-only SHA-256 hash-chained cash journal (stdlib only). Optional India-based fixed-price micro-scripts (₹499 / ₹999 / ₹2499). No fake testimonials. Order via GitHub Issue; pay receive-only UPI after written scope.
